context_requirements: Active IL-1/TNF autocrine or paracrine signaling driven by endogenous cytokine production or exogenous cytokine in the assay
Expression of IL1R1 and/or TNFRSF1A on the cell line
Intact NF-kB and MAPK signaling to mediate transcriptional output
Myeloid or stromal co-culture for robust cytokine-driven transcriptional signatures
falsifiers: No change in NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, TNIP1, CXCL2, CCL2, or other NF-kB target genes at 6 h or 24 h in any line
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle genes at 24 h despite cytokine pathway inhibition
Strong and consistent upregulation of IL1B or TNF at 24 h across lines
Clear interferon or unfolded protein response signatures not attributable to cytokine blockade

changes: Moved NFKBIA, NFKBIB, NFKBIE, TNIP1, BIRC2, CXCL2, CCL2, ICAM1, PTGS2, IER3, BHLHE40, EGR1, FOS, JUN from proximal_up to proximal_down: inhibiting IL-1/TNF signaling lowers NF-kB/MAPK-driven transcription of these immediate target genes.

Moved IL1B, CXCR4, MMP1, MMP2, COL1A1, COL4A1, SPP1, TIMP2, SERPINE1, TGFB3, PDGFA, EDN1, ICAM3, CD44 from proximal_down to proximal_up: blocking IL-1/TNF feedback would relieve suppression and increase, not decrease, these transcripts.

Moved SOCS2, TSC22D3, NFIL3, ZFP36, DUSP4, DUSP6, GADD45B, RELB, NFKB2, STAT3, STAT1, TRIB1, TRIB3, SQSTM1, HMOX1 from late_up to late_down: these are cytokine-inducible feedback/NF-kB targets and should fall with interleukin inhibition.

Moved CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, MYC, MYBL2, E2F2, PCNA, MCM3, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, CDK1, CCNB1, STMN1 from late_down to late_up: reduced cytokine signaling removes a proliferation brake, so cell-cycle genes should rise, not fall.
Removed generic proliferation and stress genes from proximal lists; they belong in generic_effects, not proximal_up/proximal_down.
Corrected line_response: A375, A549, HCC515, HEPG2, HT29, MCF7, PC3, VCAP are not uniformly weak; A549 and HT29 have active NF-kB/cytokine signaling and should be stronger, while HA1E remains none.
Corrected kinetics from slow to fast: NF-kB immediate-target genes respond within 1-2 h, so 6 h is already a strong proximal timepoint.
Corrected magnitude from weak/weak to strong at 6 h and moderate at 24 h for NF-kB targets, with weak late effects on proliferation.
Removed unsupported evidence list; no citations were provided.
